Challenges Faced During the Field Activity

Long Travel Distances: The considerable distance to some field locations affected the time available for data collection and increased the logistical challenges faced by the team.

Limited Experience Among Data Collectors: Some data collectors had limited field experience, which required additional guidance, monitoring, and supervision to ensure that the data collection procedures were properly followed.
High Data Collection Target: The large volume of data assigned to the team placed additional pressure on the data collectors and required effective time management and coordination to meet the daily target.
